items.title: Actual Gaussian summand and mean operator norms

source.anchor: Appendix C.2 p13 Ex111-112; literal p1 product experiment, Ex107 cutoff, p12 actual mean, Fact C.5 frame
source.attribution: On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling, arXiv:2610.20492v1.
source.scope: Public uncentered summand and actual mean operator norms; centered and cosine-weighted radius is a separately labelled private consumer.

items.statement: Every actual truncated Gaussian summand and its actual mean satisfy the two operator-norm bounds.

formulae.label: Actual Gaussian summand and mean operator norms
formulae.tex: \|Y_i(\omega)\|_{\rm op}\le\frac{2rL}{d},\qquad\|\mathbb E_\mu Y_i\|_{\rm op}\le\frac{2r}{d}\quad(1\le i\le d,\ \omega\in\Omega).

assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\) satisfy \(2q+1<d\), and put \(r=q+1\). This includes \(q=0\). Positivity of \(d,r\) and nonnegativity of \(L\) are derived internally.
Use the original space \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\) with \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), where \(\gamma_j=N(0,I_j)\). The physical row is \(\Phi_i(\omega)=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\).
Put \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_i))\), and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). Source index \(i\) is Lean index \(i.val+1\).
Define \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{\|\Phi_i\|^2\le L\}}\). The cutoff is inclusive and row-specific. The Gaussian coordinate comes first in the paired matrix index.

Norms are the real Euclidean operator norm of the \(r^2\times r^2\) matrices. Expectations are actual Bochner integrals on the same original \(\mu\); the existing actual-mean theorem proves integrability internally.

The only proposition input is \(2q+1<d\). The feature bound, retained-moment coefficient \(0\le a\le1\), rank-one norm identities and actual mean estimate are proved inside the proof, with no certificate assumptions.

obligations.label: Every actual truncated Gaussian summand and its actual mean satisfy the two operator-norm bounds.

bindings.boundary: Public P proves the actual pointwise truncated-summand norm and actual-mean norm only. Its private Tests consumer proves centered and cosine-weighted centered radius 2r(L+1)/d in the same literal experiment, including q=0. The private theorem is not a public API or separate canonical node. Matrix concentration, full Lemma4.4, both main lower bounds, exact oracle/precision/TV/dimension-condition-number/worst-query-cap/expected-cost adapters, serialized main/site/source-index/globalgraph integration and purification are separate obligations.

assumption_deltas.source: Original independent standard Gaussian columns, natural q≥0 and2q+1<d, actual rows, exact midpoint features and inclusive local cutoff.
assumption_deltas.lean: Literal original product experiment and exact same row matrices, including q=0; sole hq proposition input.
assumption_deltas.reason: No alternate experiment, extra query restriction, norm/moment/mean/frame certificate or source assumption is introduced.

assumption_deltas.source: Ex111 uses the actual radial mean and 0≤a≤1, the feature estimate, and exact real operator norms.
assumption_deltas.lean: Canonical mean and second-moment results are consumed internally; all needed signs, nonemptiness, coefficient range and norm identities are proved internally.
assumption_deltas.reason: Proof ingredients are discharged inside the proof, not added as caller hypotheses. The actual mean provider establishes integrability, avoiding any use of a totalized nonintegrable integral.
